thread:
maya: Quick sync 1 tying webinar sessions to a canonical hub and cleaning up redirects. Want to avoid keyword cannibalization and have one canonical URL per webinar narrative. :eyes:
raj: +1. Do we make a single hub or keep per-session pages?
lina: Recommend a hub (hub.redwood.ai/webinar/mar-21) and in-page anchors for sessions. Hub is canonical. Keeps link equity centralized and easier analytics.
owen: Anchors work but we must canonicalize legacy session pages we control or they will compete. Also check old GA goals.
priya: Suggestion: 301 redirect legacy pages with <300 visits in last 90d to the hub anchor; for >300 visits, add rel=canonical pointing to the hub and keep the page live for referral traffic.
sam: I'll run a repo-wide internal-link sweep to update product/docs/promos to point to the new hub instead of old posts. Will mark PRs.
maya: Can someone draft concrete redirect rules? I added a rough mapping in the sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1-webinar-redirect-map
raj: I'll paste an nginx snippet we can hand to infra.
seo-bot: crawl scan: 76 legacy pages referencing webinar content, 11 pages with conflicting canonical tags, 4 302s flagged.
raj: ```
# nginx snippet
location = /old-blog/webinar-session-a {
  return 301 https://hub.redwood.ai/webinar/mar-21#session-a;
}
location ~ ^/old-blog/webinar-(.*)$ {
  return 301 https://hub.redwood.ai/webinar/mar-21#${1};
}
```
lina: We'll also add JSON-LD FAQ schema on the hub, plus per-session FAQ blocks rendered as part of the hub so SERPs can surface Q&A.
priya: I'll add a CMS field "faq_schema" and prepare one sample: ```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"FAQPage","mainEntity":[{"@type":"Question","name":"What topics are covered?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Latency, cost, routing, and rollout best practices."}}]}
```
sam: Ops checklist proposal: 1) 301 low-traffic legacy pages to hub, 2) rel=canonical high-traffic legacy pages to hub, 3) update internal links, 4) add JSON-LD FAQ + speakable markup to hub, 5) validate redirects with curl and Search Console, 6) add UTM template for webinar CTAs.
owen: QA: verify canonical header/meta, test 301s with `curl -I`, and compare GA session source after redirect. Example: `curl -I https://redwood.ai/old-blog/webinar-session-a`
raj: Who will monitor Search Console indexing and coverage issues post-deploy?
maya: I'll own Search Console and watch index coverage for a week. Ping #devex for infra windows.
priya: Messaging note: include the primary keyword cluster in H1 and first paragraph on the hub, but vary H2s per session anchor to avoid exact-phrase repetition across anchors.
seo-bot: hreflang check: found 3 hubs incorrectly tagged with en-US hreflang. Remove unless localized content exists.
maya: Timeline: redirects + canonical updates by EOD Thursday; schema and link PRs by next Monday. Everyone confirm?
raj: Confirmed, will open redirect PRs today.
lina: Confirmed for schema work.
sam: Confirmed for link sweep on staging tomorrow.
priya: Confirmed for messaging iterations.
seo-bot: Post-deploy crawl scheduled 48h after deploy.
maya: Thanks all 1 I'll assemble the prelaunch checklist and post here. :thumbsup:
